summary: A two-part guide: the first for regular people who want to set up their own Directory User Interfaces to access the Directory, and the second for ISODE maintainers who want to build portable DUAs. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Instructions for setting up a program that looks things up in an electronic phone book, with one set for users and one for the people who build it.
